answer: Votes decay each epoch and are refilled only with judged work, priced convexly per sibling. The lagoon is a registry pooling identities that share a funder, host or code fingerprint into one cluster. A sparrow, one claimed identity, is the k-th of its cluster and keeps its vote only by delivering k² reef per epoch, a reef being one fresh task graded by a randomly drawn outside judge and never reusable. An honest sparrow pays 1 reef; 100 clones owe 338,350 reef every epoch. Bribed judges, or clones the lagoon fails to cluster, break it.
